text: look let me show u. this is me sitting at exact +z camera and the image use to align with it but it no longer does and i cant get it to [Image #34]
resolution: Diagnosed the 'image used to align with +Z, now stuck top-left and can't recover' report: the top-left rectangle IS the real 3D plane (textured correctly) viewed head-on, but hot reload reset the camera (lives in plain refs) which reframed onto the small model and left the big plane cornered, and the plane+offset slider model made it un-recoverable. Fix shipped under req_1285 (gizmo placement) + req_1283 (disk persistence so a reload no longer wipes the image/placement). Confirmed StaticSurface composite is NOT clamped, so left:-99999 genuinely hides the source — the leak theory was wrong.
